question.text: Galena (an ore) is partially oxidized by passing air through it at high temperature. After some time, the passage of air is stopped, but the heating is continued in a closed furnace such that the contents undergo self-reduction. The weight (in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>kg</mi></math>) of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Pb</mi></math> produced per <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>kg</mi></math> of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> consumed is ____. (Atomic weights in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mi>mol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>32</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi>Pb</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>207</mn></math>)

solution.text:
mol of Pb=mol of O2
= 100032mol

mass=moles×molecular mass
∴    Mass of Pb=100032×207 g
=20732 kg=6.47 kg
